_comment: Tracked build/test/read allowlist so fresh worktrees (incl. the isolated UAT-evaluator worktree) can build their env and run the integrity check WITHOUT auto-approving arbitrary code. Deliberately NO general-interpreter wildcards (node/npx), NO bare `pnpm *`/`npm *` (would allow pnpm exec/dlx = arbitrary download+run), NO `docker compose run/exec`, and only read-only, subcommand-anchored git. Sensitive commands (push/merge/commit) stay in the git-ignored settings.local.json, never here.
